NSS fixtures bundled from the firefox_decrypt project
(https://github.com/unode/firefox_decrypt) -- GPL-3.0 test data.

These are REAL NSS databases (key4.db + cert9.db) with matching
logins.json files, generated by actual Firefox builds:

  test_profile_firefox_nopassword_59   -- Firefox 59, no Primary Password
  test_profile_firefox_144             -- Firefox 144, Primary Password set
                                        (password: see master_password.txt)

Known plaintexts these should decrypt to (from firefox_decrypt's
tests/test_data/users/complex.user):
